inline.text: Judges run asynchronously in its own worker on ingested traces; nothing runs inside your application.

self_hosted.text: Open source and self-hosted with Docker; some add-on features need a license key.

cost_class.text: One judge-model call per evaluation; the cost depends on the judge model and the input size, and sampling keeps it down.

explanations.text: The judge returns a score together with its reasoning.

calibration.text: Calibrate a judge against labelled examples, or compare its scores with human annotation scores.

inline.text: Input and output guards run in your application and intercept what goes into and comes out of the LLM.

self_hosted.text: An open-source Python framework under the Apache-2.0 license.

cost_class.text: The self-check facts rail asks an LLM whether each response follows from the evidence, one more LLM call per checked answer; AlignScore and third-party rails are alternatives.

explanations.text: The self-check facts rail returns an accuracy score; an explanation of it is not documented.

calibration.text: An evaluation tool measures rails, fact-checking included, on datasets; fitting thresholds to your own labels is not documented.

rows.name: Cloud groundedness APIs
rows.examples: Amazon Bedrock contextual grounding, Azure groundedness detection

inline.text: The contextual grounding check runs on each response through the Invoke or Converse APIs, or on its own through ApplyGuardrail.

self_hosted.text: A fully managed AWS service; the contextual grounding check runs in its Guardrails feature, and no self-hosted or open-source edition is documented.

cost_class.text: Billed per text unit, counting the grounding source, the query and the response.

explanations.text: Reasoning mode explains each ungrounded segment; the faster non-reasoning mode answers grounded or ungrounded only.

calibration.text: You set the grounding and relevance thresholds that filter responses; a calibration workflow is not documented.

inline.text: Luna-2 is built for real-time evaluations and runtime protection; how it sits in your request path is not documented on this page.

self_hosted.text: Luna-2 is in the Enterprise tier and can be self-hosted on-prem or in your cloud; an open-source release is not documented.

cost_class.text: No public per-answer price; the docs say a small fine-tuned model scoring each metric lowers latency and cost compared with LLM judges.

explanations.text: Luna-2 scores a metric from the probabilities of True and False tokens; an explanation of the score is not documented.

calibration.text: Luna Studio fine-tunes a metric and scores it against your human-labelled test set.
